analysis:
The PR is documentation only: a new changelog fragment (changelog.d/sandbox-setup-work-disks.md) and edits to docs/provider/cli-reference.md describing `darkbloom sandbox setup --disk`, interactive drive choice, an ownership-enable offer, and a new `disks` member in the add-on status JSON. No executable source is in the supplied units, so the Swift implementation (SandboxWorkDisk.swift, SandboxInstaller.swift, SandboxCommand) is unexamined. The text describes behavior that bears on TB-013/T-061 and A-019, which are not included in the supplied relevant definitions, and on TB-012/T-059 only tangentially.

Security-relevant claims for the implementation pass:
- The CLI runs `sudo diskutil enableOwnership <path>` in the terminal's foreground process group after an explicit default-no prompt. The CLI never reads the password. The path is user-supplied or chosen from the list, so the implementation must pass it as an argv element rather than through a shell and must restrict it to a validated /Volumes/<name> mount. Argument injection and symlink or path-confusion handling cannot be verified here.
- Each --disk path is made absolute and passed to the downloaded install.sh. That script is verified only by TLS (existing T-061 posture) and is not new trust. The doc states the installer rechecks local, writable and not-a-disk-image rules.
- The statfs check, the mounted-at-/Volumes/<name> requirement and the nearest-existing-parent logic could permit TOCTOU or spoofed-volume cases. The implementation was not supplied.
- The doc says the CLI stops on a failed plan with --disk and shows the installer's stderr lines. The implementation should avoid echoing secrets or untrusted control characters.
- External work disks carry VM images and job data. This is analogous to the cache-storage caveats in T-041 (UUID cloning, ciphertext retention, no peripheral attestation), but no consumer prompt data is described as going there.
No regression or invalidated assumption is visible in the docs alone. A review of the Sandbox/*.swift changes, which are not in this batch, is warranted to confirm the described controls.
